info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of utility billing disputes associated with customer accounts. This API enables organizations to retrieve details about ongoing and past disputes, allowing customer service representatives and billing departments to manage and resolve issues effectively. Typical consumers of this API include utility companies and customer support teams seeking to improve service resolution processes. With quick access to dispute information, businesses can enhance customer satisfaction and streamline their billing operations.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific billing dispute. This operation allows the user to acquire information about an ongoing dispute including status, resolution process, and any associated documentation.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing dispute information. This should contain the necessary details to identify the specific dispute being queried.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to billing disputes, represented as a string.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.title: Billing Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the billing dispute.

resultId.description: An identifier associated with the result of the dispute.

state.description: The current state of the billing dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the billing dispute in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the dispute result.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.description: A response schema representing the result of a billing dispute operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the billing dispute.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the billing dispute was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the billing dispute was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the billing dispute.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the total time taken to process the request in milliseconds. It provides insight into the performance of the operation.
